summary.headline: Stallion Q1 FY27 revenue rose 12.78% YoY to ₹124.68 crore while PAT jumped 79.15% to ₹18.57 crore; management says margins are partly one-off.
summary.overview: Revenue reached ₹124.68 crore (+12.78% YoY), EBITDA rose 75.85% to ₹25.27 crore and PAT rose 79.15% to ₹18.57 crore. Management attributed the margin jump to a mix of better product mix (higher HFO share), earlier logistics planning and inventory gains, splitting EBITDA roughly 50:50 between inventory gains and operations. The high-purity helium plant at Khalapur (1,200 MTPA) is complete with commercial operations expected next quarter, while the 10,000 MT R32 plant at Bhilwara slipped from a July 2026 target to end-December 2026, and Mambattu (HFO blending) is now due by year-end. Management reiterated 30-35% revenue CAGR guidance but cut the FY27 contribution expectation from the R32 plant and opened the door to dilution or debt for expansion.

segments.name: Specialty gases - High-purity helium (Khalapur)
segments.commentary: 1,200 MTPA plant ready; commercial operations expected next quarter. Management guides ~5 containers in FY27, rising to 12 in FY28 and 24 thereafter; contribution about 12% of revenue this year per management. Availability of supply, not selling, is the constraint.

segments.name: Refrigerants - R32 (Bhilwara)
segments.commentary: 10,000 MT plant, completion now targeted end-December 2026 (earlier July 2026, then March 2027 startup per funding delay). Management now expects ~₹125 crore revenue in Q4 FY27 and says FY27 contribution will 'change a little bit' from ₹250 crore; FY28 ₹500-600 crore reiterated. Current R32 price ~₹800/kg vs ~₹900 peak; guidance based on ₹550/kg.

segments.name: HFO blending (Mambattu, Andhra Pradesh)
segments.commentary: Now expected by year-end versus earlier August target; scope expanded to 12 tanks with hydrocarbon and helium capability. Management says immediate turnover uplift may be only ~10%, with margin benefit larger.

segments.name: Core / conventional business
segments.commentary: About 50% of business; management says conventional business earns roughly 10% PAT margin, with new businesses at ~24% PAT.

guidance_outlook: Revenue CAGR of 30-35% maintained over next three years; management says 'the 30-35% is intact'.
EBITDA margin expected to improve by about 3-4% over the medium term as backward integration and specialty gases scale.
Management described Q1 margins as a 'special quarter' and not sustainable at current levels; FY27 PAT margin ex-R32 expected around 10%.
Peak revenue target above ₹1,100 crore in FY28 with helium, R32 and Mambattu fully operational, at ~15% PAT minimum (per analyst's framing, confirmed by management).
Long-term target of ₹3,000 crore revenue; plan of roughly one new plant per year for three years, with timeline could stretch to six years without external funding.
Capex for proposed HFO plant estimated at ₹350-400 crore for 10,000 tons capacity; management to announce more toward end of year after R32 commissioning.
capex_capacity: Khalapur high-purity helium: 1,200 MTPA installed, commercial ops expected next quarter.
Bhilwara R32: 10,000 MT; target completion end-December 2026 (previously July 2026). Delay attributed to funding: preferential issue abandoned, rights issue funding arrived late (February).
Mambattu (AP): HFO blending plant, expected operational by end-2026; scope enlarged to 12 tanks from 5 with hydrocarbon/helium capability, requiring redesign.
Proposed HFO plant: 10,000 tons (5,000+5,000), capex ₹350-400 crore; technology transfer payment already incurred; EC approval takes ~6 months; announcement expected toward year-end.
Management says capex is within budget with no overspend.
demand_pricing: Helium: price rose sharply over past 6-7 months and is now stable at ~₹4,000/kg per management (approximate). Supply availability is the critical constraint; Middle East disruption addressed via Sharjah Oxygen tie-ups and swap arrangements; management expects shortfall and higher prices for next 2-3 years.

R32: price ~₹800/kg, down from ~₹900 peak; management says correction is underway. India requirement ~20,000 tons vs 70,000-90,000 tons of capacity coming up; export and China quota reduction (from 2028) cited as demand drivers.
HFO realisations cited at ~₹3,000-4,000/kg for the two grades to be manufactured.
Management says imports of R32 have fallen to almost negligible; own R32 volumes will be incremental, not substitutive, revenue.
AHF (raw material): management expects a glut by 2028 with buyer's market conditions; multiple domestic and global sources, with plans for more than one supplier per critical input.

qa_highlights.question: How much of the margin expansion is pricing vs product mix, and is it sustainable?
qa_highlights.answer: Management cited a combination of better product mix (higher HFO share), earlier logistics planning and high stock-keeping during the Gulf crisis; said inventory gains are roughly 50:50 of EBITDA, and that margins will not necessarily repeat.

qa_highlights.question: Is the 30-35% revenue growth guidance still intact after the R32 delay?
qa_highlights.answer: Yes. Management said the 30-35% is intact, while acknowledging the FY27 R32 contribution will change slightly from ₹250 crore; Q4 R32 revenue expected around ₹125 crore.

qa_highlights.question: Why was the R32 plant delayed and what funding was used?
qa_highlights.answer: A planned preferential issue was abandoned after a share-price spike; a rights issue was used instead, reaching the market only by February, so the planned December startup slipped to March-end under the original plan.

qa_highlights.question: What are the helium volumes and how is supply secured given Middle East shipping disruption?
qa_highlights.answer: Management expects ~5 containers in FY27, 12 in FY28, 24 after; utilisation about 20% of 1,200 MTPA next year. Supply secured via Sharjah Oxygen, swap arrangements and multiple sources; price expected to rise.

qa_highlights.question: Will the company raise equity or debt for the expansion?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said it previously preferred internal accruals, but now sees dilution and debt as likely for faster growth ('some dilution, some debt, not all debt'); no decision made yet.

qa_highlights.question: How much R32 volume is pre-sold under contracts?
qa_highlights.answer: Management declined to disclose pre-sales, calling existing understandings non-enforceable MOUs; said the company will not commit to take-or-pay contracts ahead of plant readiness.
